title: Failure classifier and tracehook orchestration for observability pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a deterministic failure-classification layer and orchestrated tracehook enrichment upstream of the metrics/log pipeline so all inference traffic is consistently labeled and routed. This ticket covers: (1) runtime changes to emit canonical error attributes (error_class, error_subtype, http_status, grpc_status, model_error_code, latency_bucket), (2) a tracehook orchestrator that applies sampling + enrichment policies and hands enriched traces to the pipeline, and (3) a set of dashboards and SLO alert mappings for timeouts, overload, model rejections, and transport-level errors. The goal is to reduce time-to-root-cause for oncall and to improve automated rollback/fallback decisions for the router and rollout systems.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits canonical attributes for >99% of inference requests: error_class, error_subtype, model_version, model_variant, host_pool, queue_time_ms, batch_size
Tracehook orchestrator applies sampling and enrichment according to policy (default 0.5% global, 25% for error_class != none) and tags traces with deterministic request hash
Metric & log pipeline maps error_class to a single index used by dashboards and SLO rules
New dashboards show P50/P95/P99 latencies and error rates split by error_class, model_variant, and route; drilldown links from dashboard to full trace/PRs
Canary rollout of tracehook enrichment runs on prod for 5% of traffic and shows no >10% increase in observability spend before wider rollout
Runbook updated with remediation playbooks for timeouts, overload, model-errors, and transport failures
design_notes: Failure taxonomy emits coarse buckets first (timeout, overload, model_reject, model_internal, transport_4xx, transport_5xx, grpc_non_ok) and optional subtypes for model errors (e.g., invalid_input, generation_failure, kv_cache_miss).
Tradeoff: higher sampling for errors increases cost but accelerates triage. Use conditional sampling (error-based high sampling) to limit spend.
Avoid PII: tracehook must not copy any user prompt into tags. Use deterministic prompt hash for dedup and linking only.
We will prioritize adding attributes in the runtime binary to keep enrichment deterministic and minimize downstream parsing complexity.
Consider future integration with rollout service so routers can use recent failure-rate signals to fallback to cheaper variants. Keep attribute names stable for 6 months to avoid dashboard churn.
telemetry_changes: New trace attributes: error_class, error_subtype, model_version, model_variant, runtime_kernel, host_pool, gpu_util_pct, queue_time_ms, batch_size, token_generation_ms
New metrics exposed: failure_rate_by_class (counter), p95_latency_by_model (histogram), queue_time_ms_summary (summary), sampling_rates_by_route (gauge)
Log enrichment keys: trace_id, request_hash, attributed_error (string), downstream_status_code
Pipeline tag mapping: map http_status 429->overload, 504->timeout, grpc 14->transport_unavailable; model SDK to set model_error_code when model responds with structured error
dashboards_to_create: Failure discovery overview: time-series of total errors and stacked breakdown by error_class (timeout/overload/model_reject/transport)
Per-model error heatmap: rows=model_variant, cols=error_class, values=error_rate and sample traces link
Router impact: latency and error rate by route and fallback events per 10m
SLO dashboard: per-route SLO exposure, error_budget_burn, and alerting triggers
Cold-start and queue-time step-chart: showing queue_time_ms distribution and correlation with batch_size
rollout_plan: Dev: implement instrumentation behind feature flag and unit tests in runtime (branch runtime/feat/tracehook-classifier)
Staging: enable enrichment for all staging traffic; validate attributes appear in traces and logs; run load test 2k rps
Prod canary: 5% traffic for 48 hours -> validate sampling and dashboards; monitor observability spend and false-positive rate
Prod ramp: 25% -> 75% -> 100% pending safety checks; update runbook and oncall rotation notes
Fallback: feature flag to turn off enrichment instantly; router will continue to function without enriched attributes
